title: Reservoir
source_topic: ICPC / The 2016 ACM - Asia Nha Trang Regional Contest
statement: A reservoir cross-section is divided into tanks by N unit-thick walls at given positions and heights; water pours in at the top left and spills rightwards over the walls. For each of up to 10^5 query volumes the task is the index of the last wall the water flows over, or zero. Positions reach 10^9 and volumes 10^15.
